Cue: ./bin/acme release notes missing required --since-tag argument
Text: Always include the --since-tag argument when calling ./bin/acme release notes to prevent error E42.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag none"}
```

Cue: missing database configuration in migrate script
Text: include the --db flag with the database connection string when calling the script

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```
